A '''palace''' was constructed in [[Coral City/Legends|Mon Calamari City]] which housed the [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|ruler]] of the planet.<ref name="Strongholds" /> [[King/Legends|King]] [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]] was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] enforcer, [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]]. in the palace and his son, [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], was crowned here shortly after the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|battle]] on the planet.
